purpose: Teach: 排斥/テロリズム/美化/道義/加担/横領/危害/儒教

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、外国人社員への排斥は厳禁だ
lines.en: Discrimination against foreign staff is absolutely forbidden in this company.
lines.style: Declarative, steady authority. Clear enunciation on each clause. Even pace. No room for negotiation—this is policy, not preference.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。テロリズム対策の社内訓練を実施します
lines.en: Understood. We'll implement anti-discrimination training across the department.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient acknowledgment. Slightly faster pace to show competence. Concrete—he's already translating the directive into action. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、PRで業績を美化しすぎるな
lines.en: Don't let our PR department oversell our performance numbers.
lines.style: Measured directive with a faint note of warning. Pause before the second clause. Emphasis on accountability, not blame. This is a correction, not a reprimand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に道義的責任を意識させます
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the team knows their ethical responsibilities clearly.
lines.style: Prompt, assuring response. Warm undertone—he gets the seriousness. Not robotic. Slightly faster delivery to convey he's already thinking through next steps.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不正に加担した社員は処分しろ
lines.en: Any employee who participates in fraud gets disciplined. No exceptions.
lines.style: Firm, unambiguous. Sharp attack on the opening. Steady, deliberate tempo. The finality in his voice comes from principle, not anger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内資金の横領を厳重に防止します
lines.en: Understood. We'll tighten audits on internal fund transfers and watch for irregularities.
lines.style: Professional, detail-focused. Shows he's moved from acknowledgment to concrete prevention measures. Confident pace. This is what competence sounds like.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様への危害となる行為は絶対するな
lines.en: Anything that could harm our clients is absolutely off limits.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Pause after the opening. Weight on 「絶対」—this is non-negotiable. Measured delivery. The calm before consequence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。儒教圏の取引先文化に配慮します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respect the cultural values and business customs of our Confucian-sphere partners.
lines.style: Respectful closing. Slightly slower, thoughtful pace—he's showing cultural awareness, not just compliance. Warm undertone. This is the note Hiroshi wanted to hear.
